future_contributions.gap: Adaptive PHY layer methods for IIoT authentication
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Dynamic PHY-layer feature selection with environmental context awareness
future_contributions.technical_approach: Integrate environmental sensors (temperature, humidity) with RF fingerprinting to enable real-time feature prioritization using reinforcement learning, adapting to SNR fluctuations and interference patterns.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables robust authentication in heterogeneous IIoT environments with reduced reliance on SDR processing power by focusing on contextually relevant features.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Leverages existing SDR hardware with embedded environmental sensors and lightweight RL frameworks like PPO for edge deployment.

future_contributions.gap: Robust methods under varying channel conditions
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Hybrid CSI-RSSI fingerprinting with temporal correlation modeling
future_contributions.technical_approach: Combine CSI and RSSI measurements with a temporal convolutional network (TCN) to model channel dynamics, enhancing resilience to NLOS conditions through cross-modal feature alignment.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Improves identification accuracy in real-world scenarios by leveraging complementary strengths of CSI (fine-grained) and RSSI (robust to multipath) measurements.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Requires dual-band hardware for CSI/RSSI capture and TCN training with augmented temporal datasets.

future_contributions.gap: Federated learning for data scarcity in RFFI
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Privacy-preserving federated learning with semi-supervised contrastive learning
future_contributions.technical_approach: Develop a federated framework where clients contribute unlabeled data with pseudo-labels generated via self-supervised pre-training, using contrastive learning for feature alignment across devices.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Mitigates data scarcity while preserving privacy through decentralized training, enabling scalable RFFI without centralized data repositories.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Builds on existing contrastive learning architectures with federated aggregation layers and differential privacy noise injection.

future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Hardware-agnostic RF feature extraction via invariant representation learning
future_contributions.technical_approach: Apply domain adaptation techniques to learn invariant features across device hardware variations, using adversarial training to minimize distribution shifts between transmitter/receiver pairs.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables consistent fingerprinting across diverse hardware configurations, reducing reliance on controlled manufacturing tolerances.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Requires access to heterogeneous device datasets and can be implemented with existing GAN-based domain adaptation frameworks.

future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Secure aggregation with encrypted model updates for federated RFFI
future_contributions.technical_approach: Implement homomorphic encryption for model parameter updates during federated training, combined with secure multi-party computation for gradient aggregation.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Prevents model inversion attacks and data leakage while maintaining federated learning benefits for privacy-preserving RFFI.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Leverages existing homomorphic encryption libraries with optimized low-precision neural network quantization.

future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Edge-AI enabled online learning for adaptive RF fingerprinting
future_contributions.technical_approach: Deploy a lightweight online learning framework (e.g., Elastic Averaging SGD) on edge devices to continuously update fingerprinting models with new data while maintaining model consistency across the network.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables dynamic threat response to emerging device clones or environmental changes without cloud dependency.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Utilizes edge AI accelerators with model compression techniques for real-time adaptation.

future_contributions.gap: Comprehensive datasets for same-model device identification
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Adversarial augmentation for same-model device fingerprinting benchmarking
future_contributions.technical_approach: Create a synthetic dataset with adversarial perturbations (e.g., phase noise injection) to challenge same-model identification, combined with real-world capture of hardware variations.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Accelerates development of robust identification algorithms by explicitly testing edge cases of minimal hardware differences.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Builds on existing datasets with signal processing tools for perturbation generation and validation through cross-device testing.
